svg.text: Pin: 20 mm bright steel bar, 392 mm long. Thread both ends M20 for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacers: two tubes 30 mm outside, 20 mm bore, 5 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Order along the pin, from the left end: nut, left rear hanger, spacer,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left arm, (open span), right arm, spacer, right rear hanger, nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The arms must turn freely on the pin; the nuts clamp the hangers only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use nyloc nuts or a split pin through each end.
